summary_en: BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P. increased its tender offer price for Kakaku.com to 3,597 yen per share (3,720 yen if a standstill agreement with KDDI is reached), up from the previous 3,520 yen (3,640 yen with KDDI agreement). All required regulatory clearances have been obtained as of September 16, 2026. The board will decide on a recommendation to shareholders after careful deliberation between the two competing offers.
title_en: Notice Regarding Partial Amendments to the Notice of Scheduled Commencement of Tender Offer for Company Shares and Warrants by BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P.
translation_en_brief:
BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P., an investment partnership advised by Bain Capital Private Equity LP with indirect investment from LINE Yahoo Corporation, raised its tender offer price for Kakaku.com shares on September 16, 2026. The new base price is 3,597 yen per share, increasing to 3,720 yen if a standstill agreement with KDDI is concluded. This represents an increase from the previously proposed 3,520 yen (or 3,640 yen with KDDI agreement).

All required regulatory clearances and approvals necessary to commence the tender offer have been completed as of September 16, 2026. BCPE Blitz intends to launch the tender offer promptly once the company's board of directors votes to recommend the offer to shareholders.

The company faces a competing offer from Kamgras 1 Corporation at 3,680 yen per share. Since both offers cannot proceed simultaneously, the board and the special committee established to review the transaction will carefully evaluate which offer better serves the company's enterprise value and shareholder interests. The company will determine its official position and recommendation after thorough deliberation.
